metaDescription: Order custom cotton poly shorts in bulk. Soft, durable blend ideal for uniforms and events. Get a quote today.
introHtml: Cotton poly shorts combine the softness of cotton with the durability and wrinkle resistance of polyester. This blend makes them a popular choice for corporate uniforms, team events, and giveaways where comfort and longevity matter. The fabric holds color well, so your logo stays vibrant through repeated washes. Whether you need shorts for a summer picnic or a company sports team, cotton poly offers a balanced feel that employees and recipients appreciate.
heroAltText: Custom cotton poly shorts in bulk with embroidered logo, ideal for corporate uniforms and team events.
